text: Pakistan Code is an official Ministry of Law and Justice initiative intended to provide public access to federal laws. Legal answers should verify applicable federal legislation there rather than inventing sections.

metadata.source_title: Pakistan Code — Ministry of Law and Justice

text: For CNIC, NICOP, POC and identity-document procedures, Asaan Qanoon AI should retrieve the current official NADRA guidance before stating requirements, fees, processing time, or application channels.

For police and FIR-related guidance, the system must identify the relevant province or territory and use the appropriate official police or legal source. It must not assume that one province's procedure applies throughout Pakistan.

Tenancy law and rent-controller procedures can vary by province or territory. Before giving a procedural step, the assistant should obtain the jurisdiction and retrieve the applicable official legal source.
